title: NIST AI RMF project review
description: Project evidence and decision checks for teams that adopt NIST AI RMF 1.0.

rules.instruction: Record the intended use, affected users, model and data sources. Name the owner who accepts risk and the person who can pause the release.
rules.verification: Have the owner review the documented scope and confirm the conditions that require human review or pausing the system.

rules.instruction: For material AI failure modes, agree on an evaluation, an acceptance threshold and a way to detect failures in use. Include expected human intervention where applicable.
rules.verification: Match each test result and monitoring signal to the risk it covers. Record gaps and who accepted the remaining risk.

rules.instruction: Revisit the risk decision when a change affects the model, its permitted tools, input data or the users it serves.
rules.verification: Compare the proposed configuration with the approved version. Verify that risk evidence and rollback guidance apply to the updated configuration.
